title: epipactis chinensis
intro: Epipactis chinensis, commonly known as the Chinese Helleborine, is a type of orchid native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis chinensis include anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
